result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/iss0995-authz-deny-attribution-log.md. New Letflow.Api.AuthzDenyLog.log_denial/3 called once from the :Deny403 branch of Authorize before Response.forbidden; key = HMAC(master, label<>1) sub-key, per-call; ids hashed HMAC-SHA256 domain-separated, truncated to 16 hex; method allow-list; route from plug_route with printable-regexp gate; atomics-pair sampler (4096 slots, 60 s, CAS, fail-open) in persistent_term; wrapper never raises and failure line carries no variable text. Two evidence-driven refinements: (R1) Plug.Router.match_path in a forwarded router contains /*glob per forward (verified by running a two-level router: /api/v1/*glob/instances/:id), so route_pattern strips /*glob and keeps trailing /*_path; (R2) sampler timestamps use system_time seconds (monotonic can be negative, colliding with the 0 sentinel) with backwards-clock treated as expired. Explicit marker mapping for platform_scope because required_permission falls through to the marker and permission_scope would call both markers platform. No new env var, boot failure, supervision change, migration, or telemetry. REWORK 1 (validator FAIL step-02b): added metadata/2 spec; rewrote test (h) with step-by-step suppressed= values (5 at 1060, 1 at 1120, absent at 1180, 49 after race); LOG_LEVEL; test (b) route /api/v1/definitions/; (i)(4) determinism stated; persistent_term race wording; capture_log audit as build step 12a. Not self-reviewed.
